correctness.rationale: Independent check by stationary time correlations rather than the supplied raw-moment recurrence: set a_n=r/(r+n²), a=a_1, f=cos(theta)−a, g=cos(2 theta)−a_2, V=(1+a_2)/2−a² and C=(a+a_3)/2−a a_2. The reset semigroup acts on f and g with rates gamma=r+1 and delta=r+4. Since f²=V+g/2−2af, for ordered times 0,x,x+y the triple correlation is exp(−gamma y)[exp(−delta x) C/2−2a exp(−gamma x)V]. Three time integrals for the stationary exponential filter, split into six time orderings, give 2 v³/[beta(2 beta+gamma)] times [C/(2(beta+delta))−2aV/(beta+gamma)]. Exact symbolic factoring of this expression reproduced every factor in the Finding, giving −11776/197505 at beta=v=1, r=1/2. Bounded angular forcing, stable filtering and the independent Gaussian OU thermal part justify the integrals and the D-independent third cumulant, including at D=0. Strictness extends over the whole positive parameter range by positivity of every denominator factor and of the polynomial in the numerator. For the contextual free statement, stationarity of the angular preparation matters: the longitudinal-minus-transverse velocity-covariance prefactor is a_2−a²=r(1−2r)/[(r+4)(r+1)²] and both decay at rate gamma, so the free-displacement covariance is isotropic at r=1/2 for all lags under this preparation, with zero cross term by reflection. This is not a claim of finite-time equality for arbitrary initial headings. The uploaded check was read but not run.

value.rationale: Orientation-only resetting in the trap is a motivated protocol not reducible to complete resets. The first odd centered position moment is a natural quantitative test of stationary asymmetry: the strict sign has no rate or trap-strength reversal and cannot be removed by thermal diffusion or by tuning the rate to eliminate the free covariance anisotropy. The exact formula is useful without claiming a density classification or priority for the free-space comparison.
